analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive trading days. RSI is consolidating around the 50 level, showing a lack of direction. MACD histogram is improving in negative territory but remains weak. Volume has increased, but price is stalled at the swing resistance ($82,262.21), lacking upward momentum. Consolidation continues at 41.3% of the 52-week high.
